title: OpenAPI Generate Executor
description: Inferred on a project tagged generate:openapi. Render the project's contracts to OpenAPI plus one mcp-<ContractClass>-tools.json per MCP contract, with the consumer's own @webpieces/openapi-generator, into the outputPath of the ONE target this target dependsOn (the api library's build — its @nx/js:tsc step).

manifest.description: Workspace-relative path to the project's openapi.manifest.json. No default.

format.description: Which serializations of the OpenAPI documents to write, and therefore publish. No default.
